items.title: Split the monolith safely
items.notes: Almost all logic lives in one ~18k-line index.html. High regression risk. Not a day-one ship blocker, but blocks fast safe iteration.

items.title: Restore / document content build tooling
items.notes: Comments reference scripts/build-v12-skeleton.mjs; scripts folder is missing from the repo.

items.title: Formal Cursor Environment (optional)
items.notes: No linked Cursor Environment / environment.json. Static site still works; Builds are polish, not a gate.

items.title: Fill CT/CE Learn bank (or safe fallback)
items.notes: Default Learn level is ctce. learn-data/ctce-tasks.js = 109 subtopics, 0 tasks. Free users hit Coming soon. B1/B2/C1 have content but are premium-locked. #1 school-year blocker.

items.title: Real sell / premium path
items.notes: Premium today = code hash, not checkout. Points buy themes/variants. Cannot cleanly sell to a school cohort without payment or school license + account flow.

items.title: Decide / communicate 2025 Analogue gap
items.notes: Official variants 51–60 exist; Analogue tops out at 50. Fine if marketed clearly; incomplete if selling full 2025 coverage.

items.title: RU/EN language decision
items.notes: SEO/meta Russian; in-app UI mostly English. Decide student UI vs parent-facing copy.

items.title: Landing conversion pass
items.notes: Brand exists; little proof above the fold (counts, phone-ready, what free unlocks). System fonts only.

intakeLog.outcome: Site + write-down share one file; urgency editable on site
